description_en: Queries the list of hybrid cloud domain names

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID

parameters.help_en: The IP address or domain name of the origin server that corresponds to the domain name
parameters.help_zh: 域名对应的源站服务器IP或服务器回源域名

parameters.help_en: The page number to return in a paging query. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: 10, which indicates 10 entries per page

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether public cloud disaster recovery is enabled. Valid values:

true: Public cloud disaster recovery is enabled.

false: Public cloud disaster recovery is not enabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启公共云容灾。取值：

true：表示开启公共云容灾。

false：表示不开启公共云容灾
parameters.name: cname_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland

WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
